mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in CPIAUCSL signals a 'soft landing' scenario where policy easing supports equities without recession, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) triggers Fed accommodation that supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1150.0) signal weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with HOUST < 1150.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals demand fragmentation that precedes market corrections, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with HOUST decline and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production growth (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5%) signals supply chain constraints and manufacturing weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with INDPRO growth rate < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
